string.name: desc
string.value: Quickly fires rounds. Continuously fires when you hold down the skill key, and you can move left and right while shooting. If you learn the Rapid Fire skill, you can #cuse Broadside#.\nRequired Skill: #cTriple Fire Lv. 20#
